contentEn:
Commercial renovation in Burnaby BC is rising as business owners modernize retail storefronts, convert warehouse space, and upgrade clinics and offices across Metro Vancouver. Reno Stars has completed four commercial renovation projects in Burnaby and nearby — including a dental clinic and a retail buildout in Metrotown — and this guide shares what those projects actually cost, what Burnaby's permit process requires, and how to plan your build so it passes inspection the first time.

What Does a Commercial Renovation Cost in Burnaby BC?

Commercial renovation costs in Burnaby in 2026 range from $150 to $400 per square foot depending on the scope and whether the work triggers a change-of-use classification under the British Columbia Building Code. A simple retail refresh — new flooring, fresh paint, upgraded lighting — typically runs $150–$250/sq ft. A full tenant improvement involving structural changes, new plumbing, or mechanical reconfiguration commonly reaches $250–$400/sq ft or higher.

  • Retail buildout (Metrotown storefront, 800 sq ft): $120,000–$320,000 total
  • Dental clinic renovation (treatment room reconfiguration, new plumbing): $180,000–$450,000 total
  • Warehouse-to-office conversion (2,000 sq ft): $300,000–$800,000 total
  • Single-tenant commercial unit refresh: $15,000–$60,000

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, or whole-home renovation instead? Get a free quote from Reno Stars for your residential project in Burnaby or any Metro Vancouver city.

Burnaby Commercial Building Permits: What Requires a Permit in 2026

Burnaby adopts the BC Building Code and requires a commercial building permit for any work that changes the occupancy classification, adds or removes partitions affecting fire separations, modifies structural elements, or alters plumbing and mechanical systems. A change of use from, for example, warehouse to daycare or clinic triggers a full review and must meet the current accessibility requirements under BC Building Code 2018 as amended.

The City of Burnaby's permit fees for commercial tenant improvements are tiered by estimated construction value:

  • Value under $50,000: $1,000–$1,500 permit fee
  • Value $50,000–$200,000: $1,500–$3,500
  • Value over $200,000: $3,500 base + additional charges per $1,000 of construction value

Building permit timelines in Burnaby for commercial TI work average 4–8 weeks for routine renovations with complete documentation. Incomplete applications or change-of-use classifications add 2–4 weeks. Interior demolition-only permits can sometimes be issued over the counter if no structural or fire-separation work is involved.

Three Burnaby Commercial Renovation Projects by Reno Stars

Retail Buildout in Metrotown, Burnaby

Reno Stars completed a full retail renovation in the Metrotown area — one of Burnaby's highest-traffic commercial zones. The 800-square-foot storefront received new display fixtures, upgraded LED lighting to meet current energy standards, and a reconfigured sales floor layout to improve customer flow. The project stayed within the original budget and passed the City of Burnaby inspection without a re-inspection callback.

Dental Clinic Renovation in Burnaby

A dental clinic renovation in Burnaby required reconfiguration of two treatment rooms, new dental-grade plumbing for specialized equipment, and accessibility upgrades to meet current BC Building Code requirements for public commercial spaces. The Reno Stars team managed the permit application process with the City of Burnaby directly, coordinating with a structural engineer for the partition reconfiguration and a mechanical engineer for the new dental equipment connections. The project completed in two phases to allow the clinic to maintain partial operations.

Commercial Warehouse Door Replacement in Burnaby

A warehouse facility in Burnaby required replacement of two roll-up loading bay doors and associated structural repairs to the door frames. The work required a building permit due to the structural nature of the header modifications. Reno Stars sourced commercial-grade insulated roll-up doors, coordinated the concrete repair work, and passed the final inspection with no re-inspection required.

How Long Does a Commercial Renovation Take in Burnaby?

Timeline depends on scope and permit requirements:

  • Minor interior refresh (no permit required): 2–6 weeks
  • Retail or office TI with permit: 6–12 weeks
  • Change-of-use or structural work: 12–20 weeks
  • Large warehouse conversion: 16–24 weeks

Phase construction — completing one portion of the space while the rest stays operational — is common for retail and clinic renovations and adds roughly 2–4 weeks to the overall schedule but avoids business interruption losses.

Do You Need a Fire Safety Inspection for Commercial Renovation in Burnaby?

Yes. Burnaby Fire Department reviews are required as part of the commercial building permit for any occupancy classification change, fire-suppression system modification, or work affecting emergency egress routes. A fire safety inspection must be passed before the City of Burnaby issues an occupancy permit for the renovated space.

Is Burnaby BC Good for Commercial Renovation in 2026?

Burnaby's commercial real estate market is active across four major nodes — Metrotown, Brentwood, Lougheed, and the Riverway corridor — with a mix of older retail strip units, purpose-built office, and industrial flex space. Rent for commercial space in Burnaby averages $28–$55/sq ft net in 2026 depending on the node and condition, making renovation to modernize an existing unit often more cost-effective than relocating. Business owners renovating in Burnaby should budget for a contingency of 15–20% given current material cost volatility and skilled trade availability in Metro Vancouver.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a permit for interior painting and flooring in a Burnaby commercial space?

No. Cosmetic work that does not alter the occupancy classification, fire separations, structural elements, or plumbing and mechanical systems generally does not require a City of Burnaby building permit. However, if the space is changing use — for example from retail to restaurant — a change-of-use review and building permit are required regardless of how minor the cosmetic work is.

Can Reno Stars manage the permit process with the City of Burnaby?

Yes. For commercial tenant improvement projects, Reno Stars coordinates the permit application, engages required engineers, and manages the inspection schedule with the City of Burnaby Building Division. The client provides the scope; Reno Stars handles the regulatory coordination.

What accessibility standards must a commercial renovation in Burnaby meet?

All commercial renovations must meet BC Building Code 2018 accessibility requirements for the area being renovated, including accessible washrooms, door hardware, path of travel, and signage. If the renovation area is more than 20% of the total floor area, the entire path of travel from the entrance must be brought up to current accessibility standards.

How do I verify a contractor is licensed for commercial work in BC?

Ask for their BC Residential Builder ID (for residential) or confirmation of commercial liability insurance for the project value. Reno Stars carries commercial general liability coverage and can provide a certificate of insurance naming the property or property management company as additionally insured before work begins.

本拿比的商业装修需求正在增长，企业主们纷纷翻新零售店面、改造仓库空间、升级诊所和办公室。Reno Stars已在为本拿比及大温其他地区完成了四个商业装修项目——包括一间牙科诊所和Metrotown的零售店铺装修。本文分享这些项目的真实成本、本拿比的许可证申请流程，以及如何一次通过验收。

本拿比商业装修费用是多少？

2026年本拿比商业装修费用为每平方英尺150至400加元，视乎工程范围及是否涉及用途变更分类。简单零售店面翻新（地板刷新、墙面重刷、灯具升级）通常为150至250加元/平方英尺。涉及结构改动、新增管道或机械重新配置的全面租户装修可达250至400加元/平方英尺或更高。

  • Metrotown零售店铺装修（800平方英尺）：总费用120,000至320,000加元
  • 牙科诊所装修（治疗室重新配置、新管道）：总费用180,000至450,000加元
  • 仓库改办公室（2,000平方英尺）：总费用300,000至800,000加元
  • 单租户商业单位翻新：15,000至60,000加元

如果您有厨房、浴室或全屋装修需求，立即联系Reno Stars获取免费报价。

本拿比商业建筑许可证：2026年哪些工程需要许可证

本拿比采用BC省建筑规范（BC Building Code），以下情况需要申请商业建筑许可证：改变占用分类、增减影响防火分隔的隔断、修改结构构件，或改动管道和机械系统。改变用途（例如仓库改为日托或诊所）须接受全面审查，并须符合现行的无障碍要求。

本拿比市对商业租户装修的许可证费用按工程预算价值分级：

  • 工程价值低于50,000加元：许可证费用1,000至1,500加元
  • 工程价值50,000至200,000加元：1,500至3,500加元
  • 工程价值超过200,000加元：基础3,500加元加每1,000加元建筑价值的附加费用

本拿比商业装修建筑许可证常规审理时间平均为4至8周。用途变更或文件不完整的申请需额外2至4周。

Reno Stars的三个本拿比商业装修案例

Metrotown零售店铺装修

Reno Stars在本拿比最具活力的商业区之一Metrotown完成了一间零售店铺的全面装修。这间800平方英尺的店面更换了全新展示货架、升级LED灯具以符合现行节能标准，并重新配置了销售区平面布局以改善客流。工程在原预算内完成，并一次性通过了本拿比市的验收，无需复检。

本拿比牙科诊所装修

本拿比一间牙科诊所的装修涉及两间治疗室的重新配置、专业牙科设备的新管道铺设，以及按BC建筑规范要求进行的无障碍升级。Reno Stars团队直接管理与本拿比市的许可证申请流程，协调结构工程师处理隔断重新配置，并联系机械工程师进行新牙科设备接口的对接。工程分两阶段完成，以确保诊所可在施工期间保持部分运营。

本拿比商业仓库门更换

本拿比一间仓库设施需要更换两个卷帘装载门及门框相关的结构修复。由于涉及门头结构修改，该工程须申请建筑许可证。Reno Stars采购了商用级保温卷帘门、协调混凝土修复工作，最终一次通过最终验收，无需复检。

本拿比商业装修需要多长时间？

时间取决于工程范围和许可证要求：

  • 轻微内部翻新（无需许可证）：2至6周
  • 零售或办公室租户装修（含许可证）：6至12周
  • 用途变更或结构工程：12至20周
  • 大型仓库改造：16至24周

分阶段施工——在部分空间保持运营的同时完成另一部分——是零售和诊所装修的常见做法，虽然整体工期延长2至4周，但可避免业务中断损失。

本拿比商业装修是否需要消防安全检查？

需要。用途变更、防火系统改造或影响应急疏散通道的工程，须由本拿比消防局进行审查，作为商业建筑许可证流程的一部分。翻新空间获得本拿比市颁发占用许可证之前，必须通过消防安全检查。

2026年在本拿比进行商业装修值得吗？

本拿比商业房地产市场活跃，分布于Metrotown、Brentwood、Lougheed和Riverway走廊四大节点，包括零售裙楼、写字楼和工业灵活空间。2026年本拿比商业租金平均为每平方英尺28至55加元（净租），视节点和空间状况而定，因此翻新现有空间通常比搬迁更具成本效益。业主在为本拿比装修做预算时，应预留15%至20%的应急储备，以应对当前大温地区材料和熟练工人供应的价格波动。

常见问题

本拿比商业空间的室内粉刷和地板更换需要许可证吗？

不需要。不改变占用分类、防火分隔、结构构件或管道机械系统的 cosmetic 工程通常无需申请本拿比市建筑许可证。但如果改变用途（例如从零售改为餐厅），则无论装修多小，都需要用途变更审查和建筑许可证。

Reno Stars能代理本拿比市的许可证申请流程吗？

能。商业租户装修项目，Reno Stars可协调许可证申请、聘请所需工程师、并管理与本拿比市建筑部门的验收时间安排。业主提供装修范围；Reno Stars处理所有监管协调事务。

本拿比商业装修须符合哪些无障碍标准？

所有商业装修须符合BC建筑规范2018版对所装修区域的无障碍要求，包括无障碍洗手间、门五金、通道和标识。如装修区域超过总楼层面积的20%，则从入口起的整个通道流线须按现行无障碍标准进行改造。

如何核实承包商在BC省有商业工程资质？

要求查看其BC省住宅建筑商ID（住宅项目）或商业一般责任险保单，确认工程价值对应的保险覆盖范围。Reno Stars持有商业一般责任险，可在工作开始前提供将业主或物业管理公司列为附加被保险人的保险凭证。
